Class ThemeStore

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.theme.ThemeStore
public final class ThemeStore extends Object
Discovers bundled themes and user JSON files. Both the client and Theme Creator use the same loading rules. Bundled files are listed by the build, so adding a JSON to the source themes folder needs no Java registration.

      public ThemeStore(Path directory) throws IOException
      Creates the user folders and a default_theme.json if it does not already exist. Existing files are never overwritten.
      Parameters:
      directory - normally config/avogadro
      Throws:
      IOException - if the folders or bundled default cannot be read

      public void reload()
      Refreshes discovery. A malformed file is reported and does not replace its last valid entry. Local files override bundled themes with the same filename.

    • ordered

      public Map<String, ThemeStore.Entry> ordered(ThemeStore.Order order)
      Returns a stable display order, including local and inherited palettes. Rainbow order follows primary-color hue from red through violet and pink, then groups neutral palettes from light to dark. Equal colors use the displayed name and finally the filename, so filesystem order cannot shuffle the picker.
      Parameters:
      order - requested display order
      Returns:
      immutable ordered map keyed by theme ID

    • ordered

      public Map<String, ThemeStore.Entry> ordered(ThemeStore.Order order, boolean pinDefaults)
      Opens a picker with the two built-in base choices first when requested. Cycling the sort uses pinDefaults=false; this leaves the user's next Rainbow choice as an ordinary hue sort.
      Parameters:
      order - requested display order
      pinDefaults - put Theme 01/light and Theme 02/dark before the sorted remainder
      Returns:
      immutable ordered map keyed by theme ID
